title.en: Does the array contain a value

description.sr:
Napiši funkciju `hasValue(items, value)` koja vraća `true` ako se `value` nalazi u nizu, a `false` ako ne.

Poređenje radi kao `includes`: vrednosti se porede strogo, pa broj `1` i tekst `'1'` nisu isti. Za razliku od `indexOf`, `NaN` se nalazi u nizu.

Primeri:
- `hasValue([1, 2, 3], 2)` → `true`
- `hasValue(['a'], 'b')` → `false`
- `hasValue(['a', 'b'], 'a')` → `true`

Originalni niz se ne menja.
description.en:
Write a function `hasValue(items, value)` that returns `true` if `value` is in the array, and `false` if not.

The comparison works like `includes`: values are compared strictly, so the number `1` and the text `'1'` are not the same. Unlike `indexOf`, `NaN` is found in the array.

Examples:
- `hasValue([1, 2, 3], 2)` → `true`
- `hasValue(['a'], 'b')` → `false`
- `hasValue(['a', 'b'], 'a')` → `true`

The original array is not changed.

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function hasValue` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(items, value)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: `items` je niz u kome tražimo, a `value` je vrednost koju tražimo. Poziv `hasValue([1, 2], 2)` daje `items = [1, 2]` i `value = 2`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 3.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function hasValue` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(items, value)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: `items` is the array we search in, and `value` is the value we look for. The call `hasValue([1, 2], 2)` gives `items = [1, 2]` and `value = 2`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 3 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Metoda `includes` proverava da li niz sadrži zadatu vrednost.

- `items.includes(value)` vraća `true` ako se `value` nalazi u nizu, a `false` ako ne.
- Poređenje je strogo, kao `===`: `'1'` i `1` nisu isti.
- `includes` ima jednu razliku od `===`: `NaN` nalazi samog sebe. Zato `includes` nalazi `NaN`, a `indexOf` ne.

```
[1, 2].includes(2)      → true
[1, 2].includes(3)      → false
[1, NaN].includes(NaN)  → true
[1, NaN].indexOf(NaN)   → -1  (zato indexOf ne prolazi skriveni test)
```
text.en:
The `includes` method checks whether the array contains the given value.

- `items.includes(value)` returns `true` if `value` is in the array, and `false` if not.
- The comparison is strict, like `===`: `'1'` and `1` are not the same.
- `includes` has one difference from `===`: `NaN` finds itself. That is why `includes` finds `NaN`, while `indexOf` does not.

```
[1, 2].includes(2)      → true
[1, 2].includes(3)      → false
[1, NaN].includes(NaN)  → true
[1, NaN].indexOf(NaN)   → -1  (why indexOf fails the hidden test)
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.en: The shortest solution: `includes` does everything, including `NaN`.

label.sr: petlja sa posebnom proverom za NaN
label.en: a loop with a special check for NaN

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function hasValue` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(items, value)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: `items` je niz u kome tražimo, a `value` je vrednost koju tražimo. Poziv `hasValue([1, 2], 2)` daje `items = [1, 2]` i `value = 2`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 7.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function hasValue` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(items, value)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: `items` is the array we search in, and `value` is the value we look for. The call `hasValue([1, 2], 2)` gives `items = [1, 2]` and `value = 2`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 7 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Prolazimo kroz sve elemente, jedan po jedan.

- `for (const item of items)` uzima svaki element niza redom; u `item` je trenutni element.
- `{` otvara telo petlje; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 5.
text.en:
We go through all the elements, one by one.

- `for (const item of items)` takes each element of the array in order; `item` is the current element.
- `{` opens the loop body; it is closed by `}` on line 5.

text.sr:
Ako je element jednak traženoj vrednosti, odmah vraćamo `true`.

- `item === value` je stroga jednakost.
- `return true` završava funkciju, pa se ostatak petlje ne izvršava.

```
items = [1, 2, 3], value = 2:
item = 1 → 1 === 2? ne
item = 2 → 2 === 2? da → return true
```
text.en:
If the element equals the value we look for, we return `true` at once.

- `item === value` is strict equality.
- `return true` ends the function, so the rest of the loop does not run.

```
items = [1, 2, 3], value = 2:
item = 1 → 1 === 2? no
item = 2 → 2 === 2? yes → return true
```

text.sr:
Poseban slučaj za `NaN`: `NaN` nije jednak ni samom sebi, pa ga `===` nikad ne nađe.

- `Number.isNaN(item)` je `true` samo ako je element `NaN`. Isto važi za `value`.
- Ako su oba `NaN`, vraćamo `true`.

```
items = [1, NaN], value = NaN:
item = 1   → 1 === NaN? ne; Number.isNaN(1)? ne
item = NaN → NaN === NaN? ne; Number.isNaN(NaN) i Number.isNaN(NaN)? da → return true
```
text.en:
A special case for `NaN`: `NaN` is not equal even to itself, so `===` never finds it.

- `Number.isNaN(item)` is `true` only if the element is `NaN`. The same holds for `value`.
- If both are `NaN`, we return `true`.

```
items = [1, NaN], value = NaN:
item = 1   → 1 === NaN? no; Number.isNaN(1)? no
item = NaN → NaN === NaN? no; Number.isNaN(NaN) and Number.isNaN(NaN)? yes → return true
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo petlje otvoreno u liniji 2.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the loop body opened on line 2.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

text.sr:
Ako petlja prođe do kraja, vrednosti nema.

- Do ove linije se stiže samo ako nijedan `return true` nije izvršen.
- `return false` je namerno posle petlje: da je unutra, funkcija bi vratila `false` već posle prvog elementa koji nije traženi.
text.en:
If the loop runs to the end, the value is not there.

- This line is reached only if no `return true` ran.
- `return false` is deliberately after the loop: if it were inside, the function would return `false` after the first element that is not the one we want.

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Petlja pokazuje šta `includes` radi iznutra; posebna provera za `NaN` je potrebna jer `===` ne nalazi `NaN`.
note.en: The loop shows what `includes` does inside; the special check for `NaN` is needed because `===` does not find `NaN`.
